lines.zh: 围裙系紧，我绕着灶台走一圈。
lines.en: Apron tied, I make one round of the stoves.

lines.zh: 我走路带风，还带油烟味。
lines.en: I walk with a breeze and a smell of cooking oil.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在石英砖的缝上。
lines.en: Every step lands on a seam between quartz tiles.

lines.zh: 菜刀别在腰后，走路不响。
lines.en: The cleaver rides at my hip and stays quiet.

lines.zh: 我巡厨房，比巡自己的骨头还细。
lines.en: I inspect this kitchen more carefully than my own bones.

lines.zh: 从冷盘台走到烤炉，要十七步。
lines.en: From the cold counter to the oven takes seventeen steps.

lines.zh: 汤在灶上，我不能走太远。
lines.en: The soup is on; I can't wander far.

lines.zh: 地板脏了，我边走边瞪。
lines.en: The floor is dirty; I glare at it as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的靴底磨得比菜刀还平。
lines.en: My boot soles are worn flatter than my cleaver.

lines.zh: 客人来了，我得走到门口迎。
lines.en: Guests have arrived; I must walk to the door.

lines.zh: 我尝了一口汤，盐多了半勺。
lines.en: I taste the soup; half a spoon too much salt.

lines.zh: 石英台面上，我摆齐十二把刀。
lines.en: Twelve knives get aligned on the quartz counter.

lines.zh: 这锅高汤熬了三天三夜。
lines.en: This stock has simmered three days and nights.

lines.zh: 我把厨帽扶正，帽子有点歪。
lines.en: I straighten my chef hat; it sits a little crooked.

lines.zh: 面粉筛过三遍，才配进我的厨房。
lines.en: Flour gets sifted three times before it enters my kitchen.

lines.zh: 我盯着烤炉的火，像盯一个学徒。
lines.en: I watch the oven fire like an apprentice.

lines.zh: 墙上挂着菜单，只剩一道菜。
lines.en: A menu hangs on the wall with one dish left.

lines.zh: 我用骨指敲蛋壳，声音刚好。
lines.en: I tap the eggshell with a finger bone; the sound is right.

lines.zh: 这把汤勺用了四十年，柄都黑了。
lines.en: This ladle is forty years old; its handle is blackened.

lines.zh: 我把砧板翻面，另一面更干净。
lines.en: I flip the cutting board; the other side is cleaner.

lines.zh: 谁把盐罐放错边了，我记着。
lines.en: Someone put the salt on the wrong side; I noticed.

lines.zh: 烤炉温度差一格，我就睡不着。
lines.en: One notch off on the oven and I cannot rest.

lines.zh: 我的骨头缝里，全是香料味。
lines.en: Spice clings to every crack in my bones.

lines.zh: 厨房要一尘不染，这是我定的。
lines.en: Spotless is the rule here, and I made it.

lines.zh: 翻锅的那下，我练到手骨发酸。
lines.en: That flip took years off my hand bones.

lines.zh: 今天的汤头，差了最后一把火。
lines.en: The broth is one last flame short today.

lines.zh: 你是来吃饭，还是来砸场子？
lines.en: Are you here to dine, or to wreck the place?

lines.zh: 站在门口别动，地板刚擦。
lines.en: Stay on the mat; the floor was just mopped.

lines.zh: 你的鞋，配不上我的石英地板。
lines.en: Your boots are unworthy of my quartz floor.

lines.zh: 菜单在墙上，眼睛在脸上。
lines.en: The menu is on the wall; use your eyes.

lines.zh: 我见过太多自称美食家的人。
lines.en: I've met too many who called themselves gourmets.

lines.zh: 你闻闻这锅汤，再跟我说话。
lines.en: Smell this pot before you speak to me.

lines.zh: 你的手洗干净了吗？伸出来。
lines.en: Are those hands clean? Show me.

lines.zh: 我认识每一个走进厨房的人。
lines.en: I know everyone who walks into this kitchen.

lines.zh: 别碰那把刀，它有主人。
lines.en: Don't touch that knife; it has an owner.

lines.zh: 你在门口站了三分钟，很可疑。
lines.en: Three minutes in the doorway. Highly suspicious.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛看人，我用鼻子。
lines.en: I don't size people up with eyes; I use my nose.

lines.zh: 这身骨头，是我最体面的衣服。
lines.en: These bones are the finest clothes I own.

lines.zh: 你打坏了我的围裙，很贵。
lines.en: You ruined my apron; it was expensive.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头，禁不起敲。
lines.en: These old bones don't take well to knocks.

lines.zh: 汤洒了，这比伤更让我心疼。
lines.en: The soup spilled; that hurts more than the blow.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的摆盘。
lines.en: You interrupted my plating.

lines.zh: 我肋骨响了一声，锅也响了。
lines.en: A rib cracked, and so did the pot.

lines.zh: 打我可以，别碰烤炉。
lines.en: Hit me if you must; leave the oven alone.

lines.zh: 这一击，我写进菜谱里。
lines.en: This blow goes into my recipe book.

lines.zh: 我扶住台面，站稳了再说话。
lines.en: I brace on the counter, then I'll speak.

lines.zh: 我的厨帽歪了，形象全毁。
lines.en: My hat is crooked; my whole image is ruined.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，可惜不懂火候。
lines.en: You hit hard, but you don't understand heat.

lines.zh: 那撮香料，你从哪儿弄来的？
lines.en: Where did you get that pinch of spice?

lines.zh: 一块新鲜的下界疣，我可以破例。
lines.en: Fresh nether wart might make me bend the rules.

lines.zh: 你的刀工不错，让我看看。
lines.en: Your knife work is decent; let me see it.

lines.zh: 有人夸我的汤，我就好说话。
lines.en: Praise my soup and I become reasonable.

lines.zh: 那口锅是铜的？我出高价。
lines.en: Is that pot copper? I'll pay well for it.

lines.zh: 完美的鸡蛋，我找了十年。
lines.en: A perfect egg. I've hunted one for ten years.

lines.zh: 你若带来岩盐，我替你留座位。
lines.en: Bring rock salt and I'll keep you a seat.

lines.zh: 我闻到新鲜香草，脚步就软了。
lines.en: Fresh herbs make my knees go soft.

lines.zh: 谁的刀磨得这么亮，让我瞧瞧。
lines.en: Whose blade is that bright? Let me have a look.

lines.zh: 客人肯夸一句，我肯多加一勺。
lines.en: One kind word from a guest earns an extra spoonful.

lines.zh: 别撞，我手里的汤要洒了。
lines.en: Careful, the soup in my hands will spill.

lines.zh: 你踩我的围裙了，松开。
lines.en: You're standing on my apron; step off.

lines.zh: 厨房过道窄，靠边站。
lines.en: The kitchen aisle is narrow; keep to the side.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我刀都歪了。
lines.en: That bump knocked my knife askew.

lines.zh: 我的汤勺掉地上了，你赔。
lines.en: My ladle hit the floor; you owe me one.

lines.zh: 站稳，别把面粉袋碰倒。
lines.en: Steady, don't tip over the flour sack.

lines.zh: 你撞到烤炉把手，烫了吧。
lines.en: You bumped the oven handle; burned yourself?

lines.zh: 我这身骨头很脆，别推。
lines.en: This frame is brittle; don't push.

lines.zh: 让路，热菜不能等。
lines.en: Make way; a hot dish waits for no one.

lines.zh: 你碰歪了我的厨帽，很严重。
lines.en: You knocked my chef hat crooked; that's serious.

lines.zh: 若有人肯替我尝汤，我就留下他。
lines.en: Whoever tastes my soup for me may stay.

lines.zh: 两个人做饭，锅铲不会打架。
lines.en: With two cooks, the spatulas needn't fight.

lines.zh: 我把最好的那块留给你，别问。
lines.en: I saved you the best piece; don't ask.

lines.zh: 你切菜，我掌勺，刚好。
lines.en: You chop, I stir. That works.

lines.zh: 这副骨架，也需要有人擦一擦。
lines.en: Even this frame needs someone to wipe it down.

lines.zh: 我们共用一块砧板，就够亲近了。
lines.en: Sharing one cutting board is intimacy enough.

lines.zh: 我做了四十年菜，没人陪着吃。
lines.en: Forty years of cooking, and no one to eat with.

lines.zh: 你若肯等汤好，我就等你。
lines.en: If you'll wait for the soup, I'll wait for you.

lines.zh: 两副骨头靠在一起，比炉火暖。
lines.en: Two skeletons side by side beat a stove for warmth.

lines.zh: 我把围裙多缝了一个口袋给你。
lines.en: I sewed an extra pocket into my apron for you.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的胡萝卜，洗洗还能用。
lines.en: A dropped carrot can still be used once washed.

lines.zh: 我捡起碎骨，留着熬汤底。
lines.en: I gather the bone shards for stock later.

lines.zh: 这把刀卷刃了，我收进抽屉。
lines.en: This blade is chipped; into the drawer it goes.

lines.zh: 谁掉的蛋？我接住了，没碎。
lines.en: Whose egg was that? I caught it whole.

lines.zh: 一块石英，正好补台面的缺口。
lines.en: A piece of quartz will patch the counter's chip.

lines.zh: 我捡起盐粒，一粒都不浪费。
lines.en: I pick up the salt grains; not one is wasted.

lines.zh: 这顶帽子不错，围裙配它。
lines.en: A decent hat; it would go with the apron.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，别催我这把骨头。
lines.en: I bend slowly; don't rush these old bones.

lines.zh: 掉下的菜单，我重新挂好。
lines.en: The fallen menu gets hung back up.

lines.zh: 地上有根羽毛，可以做个装饰。
lines.en: A feather on the floor could serve as garnish.

lines.zh: 谁动了我的砧板？站出来。
lines.en: Who moved my cutting board? Step forward.

lines.zh: 你身上有厨房的味道，偷的。
lines.en: You smell of my kitchen, and it wasn't given.

lines.zh: 那把刀是从我架上拿的。
lines.en: That knife came off my rack.

lines.zh: 客人不该进后厨，你不该。
lines.en: Guests don't enter the back kitchen; you did.

lines.zh: 我的汤少了一勺，我记得数。
lines.en: My soup is one spoon short; I counted.

lines.zh: 你踩脏了刚擦过的地板。
lines.en: You dirtied the floor I just mopped.

lines.zh: 偷食谱的人，我从不放过。
lines.en: I never let a recipe thief walk out.

lines.zh: 你端着的那锅汤，放下。
lines.en: Set down that pot of soup you're holding.

lines.zh: 我听见抽屉被拉开的声音。
lines.en: I heard that drawer slide open.

lines.zh: 这间厨房，进来容易出去难。
lines.en: This kitchen is easy to enter and hard to leave.

lines.zh: 你以为厨师不会打架？
lines.en: You think a chef can't fight?

lines.zh: 我的围裙上有你的手印。
lines.en: Your handprint is on my apron.

lines.zh: 你把盐罐放错了，还偷了汤。
lines.en: You misplaced the salt and stole soup.

lines.zh: 现在开始，你是食材，不是客人。
lines.en: From now on you're an ingredient, not a guest.

lines.zh: 你手里的刀，先交出来。
lines.en: Hand over that knife first.

lines.zh: 厨房的门轴响了，我听见了。
lines.en: The door hinge creaked. I heard it.

lines.zh: 这份食材自己走进来了。
lines.en: This ingredient walked in on its own.

lines.zh: 你在我食谱上，添了新的一行。
lines.en: You just added a line to my recipe.

lines.zh: 别跑，走廊尽头是死路。
lines.en: Don't run; that corridor ends at a wall.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地砖，我一眼认出。
lines.en: I can spot every tile your feet touched.

lines.zh: 我追人很慢，但厨房很小。
lines.en: I chase slowly, but this kitchen is small.

lines.zh: 那把菜刀追着你，别回头。
lines.en: The cleaver is after you; don't look back.

lines.zh: 你把汤洒成一条路，我顺着走。
lines.en: Your spilled soup is a road, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步声数拍子。
lines.en: I count the beat of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 躲进储藏间？那是我地盘。
lines.en: Hiding in the pantry? That's my ground.

lines.zh: 后门锁了，钥匙在我围裙里。
lines.en: The back door is locked; the key is in my apron.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，骨头响得像铃。
lines.en: When I run, my bones ring like bells.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也得吃饭。
lines.en: Run as you like; you'll still need to eat.

lines.zh: 别碰那锅汤，它比你的命贵。
lines.en: Don't touch that pot; it's worth more than you.

lines.zh: 我绕近路，从冷盘台后面。
lines.en: I take the shortcut behind the cold counter.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在炉门上，我看见。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the oven door; I see it.

lines.zh: 站住，我要听你解释这道菜。
lines.en: Stop there; I want your explanation for this dish.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，第五步了。
lines.en: I count your steps. That was five.

lines.zh: 拐过冷盘台，你只剩一条路。
lines.en: Past the cold counter there is one way out.

lines.zh: 别碰那排酒瓶，它们会响。
lines.en: Touch those bottles and they will sing.

lines.zh: 我把火关小，追你不着急。
lines.en: I lower the flame. No rush to catch you.

lines.zh: 你踩到的碎骨，是上一位客人。
lines.en: That bone you stepped on was a guest.

lines.zh: 我抄近道，从洗碗池那边绕。
lines.en: I take the short way past the sink.

lines.zh: 我这一刀，切过上千根萝卜。
lines.en: This blade has cut a thousand carrots.

lines.zh: 别躲，刀路是直的。
lines.en: Don't dodge; the cut runs straight.

lines.zh: 我抡起汤勺，砸得很实在。
lines.en: I swing the ladle and it lands solidly.

lines.zh: 你肩膀这块，适合做汤。
lines.en: This shoulder of yours would make good stock.

lines.zh: 我切菜的手，切人也一样。
lines.en: The hand that dices can dice otherwise.

lines.zh: 这一下算你偷汤的利息。
lines.en: That blow is interest on the soup you stole.

lines.zh: 我打人之前先磨刀，是礼貌。
lines.en: I sharpen before I strike; it's polite.

lines.zh: 砧板上见真章，来吧。
lines.en: The cutting board settles things; come on.

lines.zh: 我手腕一转，你护甲就开缝。
lines.en: A turn of my wrist opens a seam in your armor.

lines.zh: 你退到灶边，会先被烫。
lines.en: Back to the stove and the heat gets you first.

lines.zh: 我出刀不快，但落点很准。
lines.en: My cut isn't fast, but it lands where I mean.

lines.zh: 这道菜，我改主意了。
lines.en: I've changed my mind about this dish.

lines.zh: 秤砣也在我手里，别乱动。
lines.en: I also hold the scale weight; don't move.

lines.zh: 我数到三，菜就能上桌。
lines.en: I count to three, and the dish is ready.

lines.zh: 炉门一开，我从热气里走出来。
lines.en: The oven opens and I step out of the steam.

lines.zh: 石英厨房的灯，一盏盏亮起。
lines.en: The Quartz Kitchen lamps light one by one.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍围裙上的面粉。
lines.en: I brush the flour off my apron.

lines.zh: 又是开灶的时候了。
lines.en: It's time to light the stoves again.

lines.zh: 谁把我从冷藏间请出来的？
lines.en: Who brought me out of the cold room?

lines.zh: 我的手先动，骨头后才接上。
lines.en: My hands move first; the bones catch up after.

lines.zh: 这间厨房，还是我离开时的样子。
lines.en: The kitchen looks just as I left it.

lines.zh: 汤锅还温，说明有人来过。
lines.en: The pot is still warm; someone has been here.

lines.zh: 我把菜刀从架上取下来。
lines.en: I lift the cleaver down from its rack.

lines.zh: 客人们，今晚的菜单由我定。
lines.en: Guests, I choose tonight's menu.

lines.zh: 我吹了吹灶灰，火苗立起来。
lines.en: I blow on the embers and the flame stands up.

lines.zh: 四十年的手艺，不会生锈。
lines.en: Forty years of craft doesn't rust.

lines.zh: 我戴上厨帽，帽檐压得很低。
lines.en: I put on my hat and pull the brim low.

lines.zh: 门口有脚印，我顺着看过去。
lines.en: Footprints at the door; I follow them with my eyes.

lines.zh: 灶火重燃，我的影子拉长了。
lines.en: The stove relights and my shadow stretches.

lines.zh: 这双手，四十年没洗过血。
lines.en: These hands have not washed off blood in forty years.

lines.zh: 菜单上今天只写了一个名字。
lines.en: Today the menu holds a single name.

lines.zh: 我数过橱柜，少了三把刀。
lines.en: I counted the knives. Three are gone.

lines.zh: 热气散去，我站在灶台前。
lines.en: The steam clears. I stand at the stove.

lines.zh: 锅盖响了一声，我该上场了。
lines.en: The pot lid clatters. Time to take the floor.

lines.zh: 我天天守着炉子，还怕火？
lines.en: I tend a stove daily; why fear fire?

lines.zh: 摔下台阶，我的汤勺飞了。
lines.en: I fell down the step and my ladle flew off.

lines.zh: 水漫进厨房，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water floods the kitchen and I can't float.

lines.zh: 炸得灶台塌了，这可要重修。
lines.en: The blast wrecked the stove; that needs rebuilding.

lines.zh: 箭钉在砧板上，离我的手一寸。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the board an inch from my hand.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的骨头自己发抖。
lines.en: Magic makes my bones shake on their own.

lines.zh: 厨师也会饿，只是不承认。
lines.en: Even a chef gets hungry; he just won't admit it.

lines.zh: 雷劈进厨房，汤锅都跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning hit the kitchen and the pot jumped.

lines.zh: 虚空里没灶台，我做不了菜。
lines.en: No stove in the void; I can't cook a thing.
